title: What is CTV advertising? How it works and how to buy (2026) | Strategus

facts.fact: Streaming made up 48.6% of all US TV viewing in May 2026, according to Nielsen (as cited by the page).
facts.quote: In May 2026, streaming made up 48.6% of US TV viewing, more than cable (20.4%) and broadcast (19.2%) put together, according to Nielsen.

facts.fact: EMARKETER forecasts US CTV ad spend will reach $36.95 billion in 2026 (third-party forecast cited by the page).
facts.quote: EMARKETER forecasts US CTV ad spend will hit $36.95 billion in 2026, and the IAB expects CTV spend to grow 15.6% this year.

facts.fact: The IAB expects CTV spend to grow 15.6% in the current year (third-party expectation cited by the page).
facts.quote: EMARKETER forecasts US CTV ad spend will hit $36.95 billion in 2026, and the IAB expects CTV spend to grow 15.6% this year.

facts.fact: CTV is priced by CPM (cost per thousand impressions), and inventory, targeting, buying method, and timing all affect the price, per the page.
facts.quote: CTV is priced by CPM, and inventory, targeting, how you buy, and timing all move the price.

facts.fact: CTV stands for connected TV, meaning any TV that streams video over the internet, including smart TVs and TVs connected via Roku, Amazon Fire TV, Apple TV, Chromecast, or gaming consoles.
facts.quote: CTV stands for connected TV: any TV that streams video over the internet.

facts.fact: The page lists four ways to buy CTV: directly from a publisher, on a self-serve platform, programmatically through a DSP, or through a managed service partner.
facts.quote: You can buy CTV direct from a publisher, on a self-serve platform, programmatically through a DSP, or through a managed service partner.
